protocol.ingestionTopology: Four independent OS processes with four durable private PGlite file databases; ordinary HTTP sources and UI, same candidate source as nominal-flow.
protocol.clock: Actual wall time for HTTP, commit and UI. Source arrival modeled in bursts equivalent to 10000/hour. Production polling excluded and reported separately.
protocol.scope: Transport-only benchmark; no semantic accuracy, autonomous decision throughput, human comprehension or field impact is inferred. Both process topologies remain reported.
